messages:
maria_sales: Pasting Orchid Health's RFI thread here — three open items they called out: POC timeline & cost, KMS/HSM options + SOC2 evidence, and latency/SLA for dedicated pools. I attached a draft capability matrix and a rough POC plan. SE/security, can you take?

jake_sol_eng: On POC timing — 4 weeks is doable. Week 1 infra + data onboarding, Week 2 model tuning and evals, Week 3 scale tests, Week 4 KT and sign-off. Need their sample payloads and target p99 numbers to size capacity.

orchid_poc: Thanks. p99 target: 150ms for ~512-token prompts. Expected steady load: ~80 reqs/s, bursts to ~400/s. We can share sample logs and a small labeled dataset. KMS requirement: customer-managed keys, HSM compliance (FIPS 140-2).

sam_security: We support BYOK through Cloud KMS integrations for Hosted, and full HSM integration for Private deployments. Note: HSM-backed keys for on-prem require our Private package + integration work (engineering time). I'll attach SOC2 Type II summary and encryption-at-rest docs.

maria_sales: Quick pricing/legal Q: rough POC cost for 4 weeks on Dedicated with 2x A100-equivalent capacity? Also what's the support coverage during POC (SLA/escalation)?

leo_product: Baseline estimate: ~ $18k for 4 weeks on reserved Dedicated capacity sized to 2x A100 equivalent with modest buffer. If they want Private + HSM we'll need separate infra + SOW (adds on engineering hours). Support: standard POC includes business-hours SRE and 1 dedicated escalation engineer for the core test window; premium 24/7 support can be added for an uplift.

jake_sol_eng: Tech recs: recommend using open Falcon-180B q4 quantized variant for best latency/cost balance. Default test runtime: batching=auto, max_seq=1024, KV cache enabled. Sample runtime config below.

```
runtime:
  model: falcon-180b-q4
  batch_size: auto
  max_seq: 1024
  kv_cache: true
  quant_profile: q4_8
routing_policy:
  primary: dedicated
  fallback: hosted
```

maria_sales: Uploading capability matrix and security pack links: https://drive.redwood/example/orchid-cap-matrix.xlsx and https://drive.redwood/example/orchid-security.zip — please review before I send to the customer.

sam_security: :eyes: I'll review HSM integration notes. Two important asks from our side to meet their requirement: (1) attestation for key usage logs, (2) separation-of-duties evidence for key access. We can provide audit log exports and KMS access logs from Private deployments.

orchid_poc: Can you confirm per-token rates during the POC for Dedicated vs Hosted? Also what happens if we go over the burst buffer — any throttling or hard outage?

leo_product: Hosted per-token baseline (non-promotional): $0.0008 / 1k tokens. Dedicated effective unit cost at reserved commit: ~ $0.00045 / 1k tokens. Overages above burst buffer billed at ~1.6x reserved rate; no hard throttle unless capacity entirely exhausted — then automatic fallback to hosted (if enabled) or queued requests depending on policy. We'll include a small pricing table in the RFI.

maria_sales: Action items: Jake -> final POC runbook + runtime config by EOD Wed. Sam -> HSM/SOC2 one-pager + attestation checklist by Thu. Leo -> formal pricing table (hosted vs dedicated vs private) and overage policy. I'll assemble and send consolidated RFI reply. cc @deploy-bot for doc uploads.

deploy-bot: Document uploaded: orchid-cap-matrix.xlsx (internal link)

jake_sol_eng: Draft runbook uploaded: https://drive.redwood/example/orchid-runbook.md — includes telemetry hooks, perf targets, and sample load generator curl. Example load call: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.run/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>" -d '{"model":"falcon-180b-q4","input":"<sample>"}'`

maria_sales: Thanks team. Orchid — expect consolidated RFI response by Friday 11:00am PT. If you need faster turnaround we can squeeze in a short call tomorrow.

orchid_poc: Friday works. Can we do a 30m sync tomorrow to confirm payload shape and telemetry? 10:00am PT preferred.

maria_sales: Booked — sending calendar invite. :calendar:
